propositions: A cancelled or timed-out CI job casts Verified -1 with message 'CANCELLED: <url>' that names neither the job nor the failure reason, making triage require manual inspection of the run.
The gerrit-review-action hardcodes its vote message as '${STATUS}: ${SERVER_URL}' with no input for custom detail text, so enrichment must be posted as a separate comment-only review.

The mutation gate's 30-minute timeout produces identical 'CANCELLED' votes whether caused by timeout or by unrelated version-skew failures, leaving authors unable to distinguish actionable from non-actionable failures.
A new scripts/summarize_ci_failures.py step must fetch per-job annotations and render each non-successful job with its outcome type (TIMED OUT vs CANCELLED vs FAILED), duration, and link.

The workflow must post triage detail via direct SSH gerrit review --message (no --label) after the vote is cast, guarded on vote-type != success, so the vote is already on the change if the detail post fails.
